title: Amelia | Turquoise Floral Maxi with Elegant V-Neckline
bodyHtml:
This stunning maxi brings the luminosity of a tropical escape straight to your wardrobe. The brilliant turquoise base is offset by a vibrant golden floral print that demands attention, whilst the V-neckline and three-quarter sleeves create effortless elegance. The relaxed, flowing silhouette skims beautifully without clinging, giving you all-day comfort and complete freedom of movement—perfect for warm days when you want to feel radiant and utterly yourself.

Why you'll love it

  • Brilliant turquoise with golden floral print – vivid, luminous, and impossible to miss
  • V-neckline that flatters your décolletage with natural, understated grace
  • Three-quarter sleeves that work beautifully in warm weather and look polished every time
  • Relaxed, flowing silhouette that skims the body without clinging
  • Light and breathable – genuinely comfortable from morning to night
  • Works for holiday getaways, weekend strolls, casual Sundays, and those moments when you want to feel effortlessly elegant
  • A rare find that brings joy every time you wear it
